input: n and maxValue are integers with 1 <= n <= 10000 and 1 <= maxValue <= 10000. n=1 is an explicitly supported extension of the current n>=2 statement. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. JavaScript integer inputs are primitive safe-integer Number, excluding negative zero, NaN, infinities, fractions and BigInt.
return: Number of length-n arrays with values in [1,maxValue] and each value divisible by its predecessor, modulo 1000000007.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; working state is private. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: For a fixed final value, each prime exponent e is distributed nondecreasingly over positions in C(n+e-1,e) ways. Ascending Pascal updates compute those counts modulo M. Fully charged repeated-doubling multiplication keeps every intermediate below 2M instead of forming an unsafe Number product near M^2. Exponents are at most 13. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: With V=maxValue, E=floor(log2(V)) and M=1000000007: O(n*(E+1)+V*log(log(V+2))+V*log(V+1)*log(M)) conservative time and O(V+E+1) auxiliary space. All factorization, Pascal updates and modular-helper iterations are included. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.

helpers.name: multiplyMod
helpers.contract: For 0<=first,second<modulus and modulus=1000000007, returns their product modulo modulus using binary doubling, with no wide multiplication.
helpers.cost: O(log(modulus)) time and O(1) space; all additions stay below 2*modulus, and every helper byte is charged. Its complete definition is 264 UTF-8 bytes; separator newlines count toward total source bytes.

source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 1666 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper, Solution wrapper, signature, loop, built-in call, annotation/comment, whitespace and terminal newline. Helpers are fully charged per candidate, not free shared libraries. No imports, runtime-generated implementations or hidden source expansion are used. Any eventual judge-interface adapter is additional charged source.
